description: Close-up news photograph of House Speaker Nancy Pelosi speaking, mid-sentence, with her right hand raised toward the camera making an OK/circle gesture with thumb and forefinger. A blue flag with gold fringe is partly visible at left, consistent with a press-conference setting.

Low-angle photograph of Hillary Clinton speaking at a microphone against a dark background, wearing a blue tweed jacket and blue beaded necklace. Her raised left hand forms an OK/circle gesture with thumb and forefinger. Consistent with a 2016 campaign speech.

Photograph of former President Barack Obama speaking at a lectern microphone in front of a purple-lit curtain backdrop, wearing a dark blazer over an open-collared blue shirt. His raised right hand forms an OK/circle gesture with thumb and forefinger. Third of a set of photos attached to the post showing politicians making the same gesture.

Screenshot of a tweet by user Cat Namus (@CatNamus) claiming a Q proof: that U.S. Attorney John Durham disputed the Inspector General report findings at 1:29pm, right on cue. The tweet embeds a quoted tweet from @Halfdan pairing a photo of an IWC wristwatch (hands near 1:29) with partly cropped Fox News chyron screenshots reading JOHN DURHAM ON IG REPORT, from Overtime With Harris Faulkner. The Q-proof timing claim is the tweet author’s assertion, not a verified fact.

description: Black-and-white meme image (apparent video still) of a heavyset man in a suit and tie seated with fingers interlaced, grinning, with pixelated ‘Deal With It’ sunglasses digitally overlaid on his eyes. The man’s build, hair and jowls are consistent with then-Attorney General William Barr, a common subject of this meme format in December 2019 amid IG report/Durham coverage, but the overlay hides the eyes.
flags: Subject appears consistent with William Barr but the pixel-sunglasses overlay obscures the eyes; identification probable, not certain
